# Unlock Pulse

> Free calendar of crypto token unlocks for the next 60 days. Each unlock is rated strong (>= 10.4% of circulating supply), medium (>= 5%) or small, with the 2023-2026 record of how tokens moved against Bitcoin in the week before past unlocks. Our ratings, track record and texts are CC BY 4.0 (cite "Unlock Pulse" with a link); unlock schedules come from CoinMarketCap and DefiLlama and remain subject to their terms.

Key facts: of 100 past strong unlocks, 68% were weaker than Bitcoin in the week before the unlock (average -5.1%); medium and small unlocks behaved close to a coin toss. When trackers disagree on circulating supply we show a range.

## Data
- [Calendar, next 60 days](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/)
- [data.json, all upcoming unlocks](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/data.json)
- [onchain.json, wallets holding locked allocations: balances, outflows, findings; CC BY 4.0](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/onchain.json)
- [Method and track record](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/method.html)
- [For journalists: monthly numbers, charts, CSV](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/report/)
- [Token unlocks in November 2026: data for journalists](https://billibo6.github.io/unlockpulse/report/2026-11.html)
